def fast_pow(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    b = base % mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * b) % mod
        b = (b * b) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def main():
    n, m = map(int, input().split())
    MOD = 1000000007
    if m == 0:
        print(fast_pow(n, n - 1, MOD))
    elif m == 1:
        print(fast_pow(n, n, MOD))
    else:
        parent = list(range(n + 1))
        rank = [0] * (n + 1)

        def find_leader(x):
            while parent[x] != x:
                parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]
                x = parent[x]
            return x

        def unite(a, b):
            pa = find_leader(a)
            pb = find_leader(b)
            if pa != pb:
                if rank[pa] >= rank[pb]:
                    parent[pb] = pa
                    if rank[pa] == rank[pb]:
                        rank[pa] += 1
                else:
                    parent[pa] = pb

        for i in range(1, n):
            b = (i * m) % n
            unite(i, b)

        distinct_roots = set()
        for i in range(1, n):
            distinct_roots.add(find_leader(i))
        count_roots = len(distinct_roots)
        print(fast_pow(n, count_roots, MOD))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
